text.description_html:
Acorn AMQBP, Black Iron Oval Bean Doorbell Button Plate

The Black Iron Oval Bell Button is great for rustic decor. The Oval Bean Doorbell Button Plate has a no rust finish warranty for its smooth black iron finish. It comes packaged with the oval rose, the replacement bell button, and the installation screws. The Electric Bell Button is 2-3/8 inches x 1-5/8 inches.

Please Note This is a replacement trim only. It comes packaged with button, rosette, and installation screws. It DOES NOT include the chime.

Specifications for the Acorn AMQBP Bean Doorbell Button:

  • Material: Iron
  • Finish: Black Iron
  • Plate Width: 2-3/8"
  • Plate Height: 1-5/8"
  • Can be mounted vertically or horizontally.
  • Lifetime No-Rust Warranty!

Sold Individually
